limits: Only missing real-cell transmission is reduced: resumed work is missing chunks plus at most one index-zero completion probe. Full roster snapshots, staged-index scans, storage, and fixed cover traffic do not have a general sublinear bound.

Bounded roster retries can exhaust for an offline member. A fresh authorized event can restart eligible repair; the implementation does not promise endless polling or guaranteed recovery of permanently unavailable peers.
Advanced roster snapshots and targeted repair require server 0.1.3. Older-server fallback cannot supply the same membership proof; automatic repair with terminal PIN failures must remain suppressed.
The generation-suppressed old-server compatibility arm remains a bounded non-convergence residual, not a convergence pass.
Mixed-version browser delivery to 0.14.8 receivers does not establish that every chunk is resent: legacy receipt replay can provide partial progress.
No blind rendezvous, proof-of-work, passkey or Sybil-resistance implementation is accepted by this desync report.
These local checks are not a cryptographic audit or a production deployment.
